# cache/doctrine-adapter-bundle

> 标签: PHP

## 简介

A bundle that registers Doctrine cache implementations as Symfony services supporting PSR-6 and tagging

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 5；已收录于 php-v5, php-v7, php-v8。

## 官网

- 官网：https://github.com/php-cache/doctrine-cache-bundle
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/php-cache/doctrine-adapter-bundle.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/cache%2Fdoctrine-adapter-bundle
